en.html:
I agreed with limited enthusiasm. My own position was one reason. Another: my thoughts still lagged half a step behind the situation.

Still, I made myself change gears.

Even if Rokuhara was evil, terrorist acts against it did not thereby become good. Evil remained evil.

If we could stop it beforehand, that was plainly better. If what I had heard was merely a hallucination and we accomplished nothing... that also would do no particular harm.

Following Chachamaru, we moved through the seating. Muramasa came also, wearing an expression like indigestion made visible.

The girl's steps ahead showed neither tension nor hesitation.
